target.development_target: the frozen R3 source-local descending midrank percentile
target.external_target: descending midrank percentile among strictly positive finite source-reported values within each eligible PXD068107 technical condition

development_selection.population: all 2,724 frozen R3 eligible observations from the three original laboratory anchors
development_selection.tie_breaker: smaller regularization then lexical model identifier
development_selection.final_refit: fit the selected configuration on all frozen R3 development observations

external_evaluation.analysis_population: source-cell rows with analysis_candidate_eligible=true, rank_target_eligible=true and canonical accession present in the frozen R3 feature table
external_evaluation.access_condition: public CC0 paper-attached BioStudies source; author-run technical OOD candidate; one pooled technical source; not a protected lockbox and not an independent evaluator

feature_policy.feature_standardization: fit only on all frozen R3 development observations

metrics.primary: equal-weight mean external measurement-batch Spearman correlation
secondary: equal-weight mean external measurement-batch mean absolute error
equal-weight mean external measurement-batch root mean square error
metrics.constant_rank_metric_policy: undefined; report MAE and RMSE only

uncertainty.method: external technical-condition cluster bootstrap percentile interval

negative_control.method: permute R3 development targets independently within each development measurement batch while holding the observed nested-selected alpha fixed

claim_boundary: This is an author-run technical OOD analysis on a CC0 paper-attached source from one pooled Westlake technical lineage. It evaluates frozen sequence descriptors against source-local within-condition ranks without combining raw scales. It does not establish donor-level biological validation, an independent evaluator, external scientific reproduction, adoption or scientific submission readiness.
